Support official DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` while retaining `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` compatibility.

Admit `0.2.1-rc.5` in the declared `peerDependencies` and `engines.dsh` ranges (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5`). No plugin runtime code changes were required; the session, agent, workspace, and conversation view interfaces used by this plugin remain fully compatible with official DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`.

在声明的 `peerDependencies` 与 `engines.dsh` 兼容范围（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5`）中显式纳入官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`，同时保持对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的支持。无需改动插件运行时代码；本插件使用的会话、智能体、工作区及对话视图接口在官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` 上完全兼容。

Validation: 57 automated tests, 4 release-tool tests, 10 publishing-helper unit tests, 13-file npm package verification, and isolated official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.5` fresh-boot and restart acceptance checks (live/cold message editing, user-message image retention, version navigation, sibling retry branching, non-overlapping version tree layout, and 400px header More-menu navigation) with an offline model.

Install from npm or the attached release archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-message-edit
```

Restart DSH after updating.
